svg.title: White over Dark Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-relief-paintings-05-2001/lightbox/works/white-over-dark-blue-1966-68-12579; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
